events.title: DAX Moves Higher As Lower Oil Prices, Bond Yields Offset Weak Economic Data
events.description: Despite weak factory orders and construction sector data, the German market gained significant ground in positive territory Tuesday morning thanks to a sharp drop in crude oil prices and lower Euro zone bond yields. Factory orders plunged 10.6% in August.

events.title: European Shares Climb As Oil And Bond Yields Ease From Recent Highs
events.description: European stocks were sharply higher on Tuesday as Brent crude prices dipped below $100 a barrel on signs of resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and Euro zone bond yields fell, helping reduce the spread between French and German 10-year yields.

events.title: Asian Shares Advance After Wall Street Gains
events.description: Asian stocks advanced on Tuesday as an apparent calm in the global oil market helped ease concerns around inflation and input costs.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Amid RBA Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday, as traders are now betting the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will likely raise rates at its November policy meeting.

events.title: Australian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday.

events.title: European Shares Set To Open Higher As Focus Shifts To Earnings
events.description: European stocks are seen opening on a firm note on Tuesday after the Nasdaq notched a record close overnight, led by strength in artificial intelligence and technology stocks.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher in early trade on Tuesday, extending gains from the previous session amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early gains in mid-market trading on Tuesday, adding to the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving well above the 8,700 level, with gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mixed on Tuesday, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid declining crude oil prices on signs of increasing supply from the Middle East to pre-war levels despite continued risks to shipping. The G7 also pledged to release 100 million barrels of diesel from strategic emergency reserves. Asian markets closed mostly higher on Monday.

events.title: Indian Shares Set To Follow Global Peers Higher
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Tuesday, tracking mostly positive cues from global markets as oil extended declines, helping ease concerns around inflation and input costs ahead of the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy announcement due this week.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Tuesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has tracked higher in three straight sessions, gathering more than 15 points or 1.0 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,575-point plateau and it may see additional support again on Tuesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading modestly higher on Tuesday, extending the gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 moving above the 70,150 level, with gains in automakers, financial stocks.

events.title: Australian Markets Notably Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is notably higher on Tuesday, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving well above the 8,700 level, with gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in energy stocks.
